related.title: IEEE 802.1AS：Peer Delay 與回覆駐留時間
related.titleEn: IEEE 802.1AS: peer delay and response residence
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：由另一學徒只使用交付檔案重建兩情境與判定；需同時保留未通過情境。 教學時間誤差預算5 µs，初值為0時最多250 s；100 s通過、300 s失敗，恢復參考後檢查漸進校正。 holdover_trace.csv、失鎖起點與誤差預算 保留輸入、逐項中間值、名義 2 與變更 6 us、反例、驗收判定與模型限制，供另一學徒從零重算。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: A second apprentice must reconstruct both scenarios and decisions using only the handover files; retain failing cases as well. Teaching time-error budget5 microseconds permits250 s from zero initial error;100 s passes and300 fails, with controlled correction after reference returns. holdover_trace.csv, loss-of-reference origin and error budget Preserve inputs, intermediate values, nominal 2 and changed 6 us, counterexamples, acceptance decisions and model limits so another apprentice can reproduce them.
related.difference: 完成兩組條件的可重算判定，指出哪些觀察能區分原因。 教學鏈路延遲需5±0.1 µs；兩情境都通過才表明駐留補償正確，不能把總往返的一半當peer delay。
related.differenceEn: Produce reproducible decisions for both configurations and identify observations that discriminate causes. Teaching link delay must be5±0.1 microseconds in both cases; half the total elapsed time is not peer delay.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 合成頻率偏差20 ppb，參考中斷100 s；擾動300 s，初始偏移設0。 名義式 20e-9*100*1e6 = 2 us；變更式 20e-9*300*1e6 = 6 us。逐項標示量綱，先代入未四捨五入數值再作比較。 手算名義式並保存所有中間項，實作下列獨立驗證而非只抄最終數字： 每秒累加20 ns，100次得到2 µs；保留正負頻率偏差，最壞界使用絕對值。
合成發送到收到回覆40 µs，對端駐留30 µs；擾動駐留增到50 µs、總往返60 µs。 名義式 (40-30)/2 = 5 us；變更式 (60-50)/2 = 5 us。逐項標示量綱，先代入未四捨五入數值再作比較。 手算名義式並保存所有中間項，實作下列獨立驗證而非只抄最終數字： 建立發出0、對端收到5、對端送出35、來源收到40的同速事件線；擾動只延後對端回覆，鏈路傳播應不變。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Synthetic frequency bias20 ppb, reference outage100 s changed to300 s, initial offset zero. Nominal 20e-9*100*1e6 = 2 us; changed 20e-9*300*1e6 = 6 us. Label dimensions, substitute unrounded values and only then compare. Calculate the nominal expression with intermediate terms and implement this independent validation rather than copying the final number: Accumulate20 ns each second to obtain2 microseconds after100 updates; keep signed frequency errors and use absolute values for worst-case bounds.

Synthetic elapsed request/response40 microseconds with30 residence; increase residence to50 and total elapsed to60. Nominal (40-30)/2 = 5 us; changed (60-50)/2 = 5 us. Label dimensions, substitute unrounded values and only then compare. Calculate the nominal expression with intermediate terms and implement this independent validation rather than copying the final number: Build same-rate events0,5,35,40; delay only the responder in the perturbation and confirm unchanged propagation.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: OPC UA PubSub：資料集與封包分段預算
related.titleEn: OPC UA PubSub: dataset and packetization budgets

related.difference: 完成兩組條件的可重算判定，指出哪些觀察能區分原因。 教學每發布最多3資料報；3000通過、4500不足，考慮拆資料集或減頻率並查重新組裝規則。
related.differenceEn: Produce reproducible decisions for both configurations and identify observations that discriminate causes. Teaching maximum three datagrams per publication:3000 passes and4500 fails; split datasets or reduce frequency while checking reassembly rules.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 合成頻率偏差20 ppb，參考中斷100 s；擾動300 s，初始偏移設0。 名義式 20e-9*100*1e6 = 2 us；變更式 20e-9*300*1e6 = 6 us。逐項標示量綱，先代入未四捨五入數值再作比較。 手算名義式並保存所有中間項，實作下列獨立驗證而非只抄最終數字： 每秒累加20 ns，100次得到2 µs；保留正負頻率偏差，最壞界使用絕對值。

合成MTU1500 bytes、有效固定開銷100 bytes，資料集3000 bytes；擾動4500 bytes，不宣稱100是標準固定值。 名義式 ceil(3000/(1500-100)) = 3 datagrams；變更式 ceil(4500/(1500-100)) = 4 datagrams。逐項標示量綱，先代入未四捨五入數值再作比較。 手算名義式並保存所有中間項，實作下列獨立驗證而非只抄最終數字： 列前兩段1400、最後200 bytes；擾動前三段1400、最後300；總載荷需精確還原原資料集。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Synthetic frequency bias20 ppb, reference outage100 s changed to300 s, initial offset zero. Nominal 20e-9*100*1e6 = 2 us; changed 20e-9*300*1e6 = 6 us. Label dimensions, substitute unrounded values and only then compare. Calculate the nominal expression with intermediate terms and implement this independent validation rather than copying the final number: Accumulate20 ns each second to obtain2 microseconds after100 updates; keep signed frequency errors and use absolute values for worst-case bounds.

SyntheticMTU1500 bytes, assumed fixed overhead100 and dataset3000, changed to4500 bytes;100 is not a normative overhead value. Nominal ceil(3000/(1500-100)) = 3 datagrams; changed ceil(4500/(1500-100)) = 4 datagrams. Label dimensions, substitute unrounded values and only then compare. Calculate the nominal expression with intermediate terms and implement this independent validation rather than copying the final number: List1400,1400,200-byte payloads and1400,1400,1400,300 after change; sums must exactly reconstruct the dataset.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
